learning_outcomes.text: Determine whether a transaction is a business combination and identify the acquirer
Apply the acquisition method and determine the acquisition date
Recognise and measure identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed
Calculate goodwill or a bargain purchase gain, including the choice of measuring non-controlling interest
Account for contingent consideration and acquisition-related costs
Apply the measurement period and account for subsequent adjustments

integrative_case: A listed group acquires a controlling stake in a target with recognised and unrecognised intangibles, an earn-out contingent on future profits, and significant advisory fees; apply the acquisition method to identify the acquirer, fair-value the net assets, choose how to measure the non-controlling interest, and compute goodwill, then explain the measurement-period adjustments made after year-end.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
